name: Doge Safety Scan

kinds.name: May be adult
kinds.says: a picture or film that may show nudity (18+)

kinds.name: May flash
kinds.says: a moving picture or film that flashes more than 3 times a second (a seizure risk for some people)

kinds.name: May be a scam
kinds.says: asks for your secret words or keys, offers free coins, or looks like a wallet login

kinds.name: Agent trap
kinds.says: words or code that try to give AI agents orders, or hide instructions for them

kinds.name: Risky code
kinds.says: asks a wallet to sign or pay, loads from outside the chain, could send data out, or tracks you

kinds.name: Miner or phone-killer
kinds.says: may secretly mine coins, or is built to freeze or crash a device

kinds.name: Hate words
kinds.says: has words or slogans used to attack people for who they are

kinds.name: Personal details
kinds.says: shows a phone number, home address or email (could be someone being exposed)

files: blocks/<height>.json: what was found in that block, inscription by inscription
about: Each inscription of the last 1440 blocks, looked at and read without running it: pictures and films (may be adult, may flash, too big for phones), and words and code (agent traps, scams, miners and phone-killers, hate words, personal details, risky code). Made by GitHub on its own, about every hour. Every finding is a "may be".
